title: Charge-Bound Warhammer

sources.title: Favoured Weapon
markers: | description = This weapon has a +1 bonus to damage and {{Attack Roll}}s.

sources.title: Galvanic Currents
markers: | description = This weapon deals an additional {{DamageText|1d6|Lightning}} damage.

summary: A +1 warhammer. Bond it to an Eldritch Knight or bind it as a Warlock Pact or Hexed weapon to gain another +1 to attack and damage and deal 1d6 extra Lightning.

fields.Binding: The two weapon effects require the specific bond. Favoured Weapon stacks with the base +1 enchantment.
fields.Base value: 310 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Reported binding behavior: The pinned source reports that the Lightning damage persists after an Eldritch Knight or Pact of the Blade Warlock binds a different weapon or another character wields the hammer. The report concerns the Lightning damage.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
